title: Terry Davis Demos SimStructure  (2016-08-25)
summary: Terry Davis, author of TempleOS, demonstrates his SimStructure physics simulator and builds a PID controller using math from Numerical Recipes in C. The description notes PID controllers are used in everything from rockets to espresso machines.
why: HN links it with timestamps as an early, hands-on demo of control theory and as a curiosity from Davis's work.

quote.text: He starts talking about PID controllers at around 3:40.
